1Ī: the imperative spelled ī (the manuscripts of Plautus, ei). Plaut. Asin. 108.

Ī1, bene ambulā.

off you go, safe journey

Examples

  • bene ambulā et redambulā

    safe journey there and back (Plaut. Capt. 900)Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

See also goodbye, have a good flight, come back soon.
